assistant.subtitle: AI-powered wellbeing support

assistant.disclaimer: MindGuard is an AI companion for emotional wellbeing and not a substitute for medical or clinical therapy.

landing.heroTitle3: Get support when you need it.
landing.heroDesc: MindGuard notices small shifts in mood, sleep and stress early through gentle daily check-ins and offers grounded, supportive guidance long before things feel unmanageable.
landing.medicalDisclaimer: MindGuard offers wellbeing support, not medical diagnosis. In an emergency, contact local emergency services immediately.
landing.problemTitle: Most people notice burnout only after it's already here.
landing.problemDesc: Stress, poor sleep and low mood build quietly across weeks of check-ins and journal entries invisible day-to-day, obvious only in hindsight. MindGuard exists to catch the pattern earlier.
landing.step1Desc: A 30-second mood, sleep, stress and focus check-in — with an optional journal entry.
landing.step2Desc: AI models detect emotion, stress topics and recurring patterns in what you write.
landing.step3Desc: A wellbeing status, personalized plan, and a nudge toward human support when it matters.
landing.privacyDesc: Journal content is analyzed to support you never sold, never shared without consent, and flagged situations are reviewed by real people before any escalation happens.
landing.ctaDesc: Two minutes a day is enough for MindGuard to start noticing what matters.

footer.disclaimer: A wellbeing-support signal, not a diagnosis. Always seek professional help for medical concerns.
footer.emergencyNotice: If you're in crisis, please contact local emergency services or a crisis helpline immediately.
